scope: All 221 original git-tracked tests/data files at snapshot; static parsing only.

method.raw: Each recorded half-open byte range was individually returned in an exec_command result capped at 8500 bytes, all natural-language query strings/policies/landmark narratives and historical TXT. Two query files were re-read after aggregate-output truncation.
method.structured: Every JSON/GeoJSON node recursively visited, including all numeric coordinates/timing/export values; full-file SHA256 and UTF-8 JSON decoding, duplicate-key/non-finite checks. No claim of manual prose reading numeric/enum tables.
method.symbolNavigation: Attached apex-lsp lsp_definition FrameLights -> current production declaration; file associations use text searches.
limits: Does not prove current runtime golden parity, benchmark validity or coverage behavior.
Literal reference map is not complete dynamic producer/consumer analysis.
Object shapes count all object occurrences; arbitrary object key names are preserved rather than normalized.

cleanupCandidates.action: Confirm intended archival/provenance role before removal; full raw source retained.
Eligible for normal ratchet fold review, never manually delete or rewrite generated ratchets.
Missing-path lists are evidence for producer-controlled pruning; timings are scheduling hints, not test coverage.
